page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Running head at the top: page number at left, title "De Episcopatu" centred, chapter marker "Q. XIV." at right. No marginal notes, no footnotes. Catchword "in" at the lower right.

main_text.p: currere, adeoque privationem jurisdictionis & dignitatum suarum &c. Quarto consequenter necessaria est hæc doctrina ad tuendam vitam, dignitates, bona Magistratus Christiani, imò cujuscunque Christiani, ut pręcipuè patet ex connexione inter dominium spirituale & temporale, quemadmodum Bellar. non inepte profectò, sed callidius longè, quàm plerique alii Pontificii, hoc ex illo infert. Quinto eò spectat doctrina ista, ut Magistratus Christiani intelligentes potestatem suam in rebus Ecclesiasticis adeoq; officium suum, eò magis excitimulentur, ad procurandum bonum Religionis atq; Ecclesiæ, ad extendendum Regnum Jesu Christi; quandoquidem vident ad se etiam pertinere curam religionis & Ecclesiæ iis modis, qui à nobis sunt expositi. Sextus usus est, ut Doctores & Pastores Ecclesiæ aliæque personæ Ecclesiasticæ eo melius & rectius officium suum faciant, tàm in

page.notes: The "Q. XIV." at the top right is the chapter marker of the running head, not a heading, so it is not in main_text. "excitimulentur" is printed this way (an ink fault, probably "excitentur" or "excitantur" with an extra "i"); left as printed. "ad se" is partly obscured in the scan. "pręcipuè" reads with an ę-like letter; checked against the scan but uncertain. The page ends with the catchword "in" at the right margin. Image has a Google digitiser stamp at the lower right, not transcribed.
